name: enterprise_data
description: Master dataset containing unflattened structs and employee records.

columns.name: [CV Employee Achievements and Awards[CV Achievement Description]]
columns.description: A description of the context or significance of the award/achievement.

columns.name: [CV Employee Achievements and Awards[CV Issue Date]]
columns.description: The date when the award or achievement was granted.

columns.name: [CV Employee Achievements and Awards[CV Title]]
columns.description: The title of a professional award or achievement listed on the employee's CV.

columns.name: [CV Employee Competencies[Technical Competency Name]]
columns.description: A specific skill or competency listed related to the employee. This can include languages, hard skills, soft skills.

columns.name: [CV Employee Education[CV Degree Name]]
columns.description: The name of a degree as self-reported on the employee's CV.

columns.name: [CV Employee Education[CV End Date]]
columns.description: The end date of an education entry on the employee's CV.

columns.name: [CV Employee Education[CV Institution Name]]
columns.description: The name of an educational institution as self-reported on the employee's CV.

columns.name: [CV Employee Education[CV Start Date]]
columns.description: The start date of an education entry on the employee's CV.

columns.name: [CV Employee Interest and Hobbies[CV Interest Description]]
columns.description: Details describing the nature or level of engagement in the hobby/interest.

columns.name: [CV Employee Interest and Hobbies[CV Interest Name]]
columns.description: A specific hobby or personal interest listed on the employee's CV.

columns.name: [CV Employee Summary[CV Employee Summary]]
columns.description: A professional profile summary or biography extracted from the employee's CV.

columns.name: [CV Employee Work Experience[CV Company Name]]
columns.description: A company name listed in the work experience section of the employee's CV.

columns.name: [CV Employee Work Experience[CV End Date]]
columns.description: The end date of a work experience entry on the CV.

columns.name: [CV Employee Work Experience[CV Job Title]]
columns.description: A job title listed in the work experience section of the employee's CV.

columns.name: [CV Employee Work Experience[CV Responsibilities Summary]]
columns.description: A summary of duties and responsibilities for a role listed on the employee's CV.

columns.name: [CV Employee Work Experience[CV Start Date]]
columns.description: The start date of a work experience entry on the CV.

columns.name: [Employee Achievements[Customary Name]]
columns.description: The year of the performance cycle being evaluated.

columns.name: [Employee Achievements[Employee OA Comments]]
columns.description: The employee's comments regarding the 'Overall Assessment' (OA) of the employee's performance.

columns.name: [Employee Achievements[Manager OA Comments]]
columns.description: The manager's comments regarding the 'Overall Assessment' (OA) of the employee's performance.

columns.name: [Employee Assignment History[Assignment End Date]]
columns.description: The date when a specific historical assignment ended.

columns.name: [Employee Assignment History[Assignment Experience (Years & Months)]]
columns.description: The duration of experience gained during a specific assignment, expressed in years and months.

columns.name: [Employee Assignment History[Assignment Name]]
columns.description: The name of a specific job assignment or role in the employee's history with the company.

columns.name: [Employee Assignment History[Assignment Start Date]]
columns.description: The date when a specific historical assignment began.

columns.name: [Employee Assignment History[Employee Grade]]
columns.description: The employee grade held during a specific historical assignment.

columns.name: [Employee Assignment History[Position Title]]
columns.description: The position title held during a specific historical assignment.

columns.name: [Employee Competencies Rating[Competancy Name]]
columns.description: The name of a standard organizational competency being evaluated (e.g., 'Digital Saviness', 'Entrepreneurship', 'Public Service Excellence', 'Learning Agility').

columns.name: [Employee Competencies Rating[Employee Rating]]
columns.description: The self-assessment score given by the employee for a specific competency.

columns.name: [Employee Competencies Rating[Employee Rating Description]]
columns.description: The employee's written justification or comment supporting their self-rating.

columns.name: [Employee Competencies Rating[Supervisor Rating]]
columns.description: The score given by the supervisor for the employee's competency during evaluation.

columns.name: [Employee Competencies Rating[Supervisor Rating Description]]
columns.description: The supervisor's written justification or comment supporting their rating of the employee.

columns.name: [Employee Leave Details[Approval Status]]
columns.description: The current processing status of the leave request (e.g., Approved, Pending, Rejected).

columns.name: [Employee Leave Details[Leave Duration (Days)]]
columns.description: The duration of the specific leave instance in days.

columns.name: [Employee Leave Details[Leave End Date]]
columns.description: The end date of the specific leave record.

columns.name: [Employee Leave Details[Leave Start Date]]
columns.description: The start date of the specific leave record.

columns.name: [Employee Leave Details[Leave Type]]
columns.description: The category of a specific leave request (e.g., Annual, Sick, Emergency, Hajj).

columns.name: [Employee Master[ADEO Experience (Years)]]
columns.description: The number of years the employee has worked for ADEO.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Age]]
columns.description: The employee's current age in years.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Assignment Status]]
columns.description: The current employment status of the employee (e.g., Active, On Leave, Suspended, Terminated).

columns.name: [Employee Master[Basic Salary]]
columns.description: The fixed base compensation paid to the employee excluding any allowances, bonuses, or benefits.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Child Allowance]]
columns.description: Financial support provided to the employee based on the number of eligible children.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Cost of Living Allowance]]
columns.description: An allowance designed to offset the cost of living in a specific region or city.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Date of Joining]]
columns.description: The date on which the employee officially commenced employment with the organization.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Degree]]
columns.description: The highest academic degree level obtained by the employee (e.g., Bachelor's, Master's, PhD).

columns.name: [Employee Master[Department]]
columns.description: The specific functional team within a Sector or Division where the employee works.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Division]]
columns.description: The highest operational division within the organization (e.g., Strategic Affairs, Operational Affairs).

columns.name: [Employee Master[Educational Institute]]
columns.description: The name of the university, college, or institution where the employee obtained their highest qualification.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Email Address]]
columns.description: The corporate email address assigned to the employee for professional communication.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Employee Grade]]
columns.description: The specific level or rank associated with the employee's current position.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Employee Name]]
columns.description: The full legal name of the employee in English.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Employee Name (Arabic)]]
columns.description: The full legal name of the employee in Arabic script.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Employee Number]]
columns.description: A unique numeric or alphanumeric identifier assigned to the employee for system tracking.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Etihad Allowance]]
columns.description: Allowance granted under the Etihad employment category policy.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Family Book Number]]
columns.description: The unique reference number for the Family Book (Khulasat Al Qaid).

columns.name: [Employee Master[Gender]]
columns.description: The biological sex of the employee.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Grade]]
columns.description: The administrative pay grade assigned to the employee.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Graduation Date]]
columns.description: The date when the employee officially graduated from their educational institution.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Housing Allowance]]
columns.description: Financial benefit provided to cover or subsidize the employee's accommodation expenses.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Job Title]]
columns.description: The generic or rank title associated with the employee's role (e.g., 'Senior Specialist', 'Director', 'Assistant Advisor', 'Director General').

columns.name: [Employee Master[Last Promotion Date]]
columns.description: The date on which the employee received their most recent promotion.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Last Promotion Reason]]
columns.description: The recorded reason or justification for the last promotion (e.g., Merit, Reorganization).

columns.name: [Employee Master[Major (Education)]]
columns.description: The specific field of study or major specialization of the employee's highest degree.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Marital Status]]
columns.description: The current marital status of the employee (e.g., Married, Single).

columns.name: [Employee Master[Nationality]]
columns.description: The country of citizenship held by the employee.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Number of Children]]
columns.description: The count of children dependent on the employee.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Number of Spouses]]
columns.description: The number of spouses currently recorded for the employee.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Office Name]]
columns.description: The organizational unit equivalent to a sector (e.g., DG Office, Chairman Protocol Office)

columns.name: [Employee Master[Organization Unit]]
columns.description: The most granular organizational business unit or section to which the employee belongs.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Passport Number]]
columns.description: The unique alphanumeric identifier of the employee's passport.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Person Type]]
columns.description: The employment category of the individual (e.g., Permanent Employee, Contractor, Intern, or Secondee).

columns.name: [Employee Master[Phone Allowance]]
columns.description: A monthly stipend to cover mobile phone usage for business purposes.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Phone Number]]
columns.description: The primary contact telephone number for the employee.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Position Title]]
columns.description: The specific official designation of the employee within the organizational structure, which may include specific team or functional identifiers.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Secondment Allowance]]
columns.description: Allowance paid during a temporary assignment to another entity or location.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Sector]]
columns.description: The intermediate organizational level situated between the Division and the Department.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Sick Leave Taken]]
columns.description: The total number of sick leave days utilized by the employee in the current period.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Social Allowance]]
columns.description: A government-mandated allowance typically provided to nationals, often based on marital status.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Special Contract Basic Salary]]
columns.description: Base salary paid under a special employment contract.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Supervisor Name]]
columns.description: The full name of the employee's direct manager.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Supplementary Allowance]]
columns.description: An additional financial allowance provided to supplement the basic salary, often used to adjust total compensation.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Technical Special Allowance]]
columns.description: An allowance granted to employees with specialized technical skills or for performing specific technical roles.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Time Since Last Promotion]]
columns.description: The calculated duration (typically in months or years) since the last promotion occurred.

columns.name: [Employee Master[Total Entitlement Amount]]
columns.description: The gross total of the basic salary plus all applicable allowances.

columns.name: [Employee Objectives[Goal Plan Name]]
columns.description: The name of the performance cycle or period (e.g., 2023 Performance Objectives).

columns.name: [Employee Objectives[Goal Status]]
columns.description: The approval status of the goal plan (e.g., Approved).

columns.name: [Employee Objectives[Goal Weighting]]
columns.description: The numerical weight assigned to the objective as a percentage of the total goal.

columns.name: [Employee Objectives[Objective Description]]
columns.description: Detailed context or requirements for the objective.

columns.name: [Employee Objectives[Objective Name]]
columns.description: The title or short description of a specific performance goal or objective set for the employee.

columns.name: [Employee Objectives[Objective Status]]
columns.description: The specific status of the individual objective (e.g., APPROVED).

columns.name: [Employee Objectives[Workflow State]]
columns.description: The current state of the objective within the performance workflow (e.g., COMPLETE).

columns.name: [Employee Previous Employer[End Date]]
columns.description: The end date of the employment period with the previous employer.

columns.name: [Employee Previous Employer[Previous Employer Name]]
columns.description: The name of a company where the employee worked prior to joining the current organization.

columns.name: [Employee Previous Employer[Previous Job Title]]
columns.description: The job title the employee held at their previous employer.

columns.name: [Employee Previous Employer[Start Date]]
columns.description: The start date of the employment period with the previous employer.

columns.name: [Employee Qualification[Educational Institute]]
columns.description: The institution that awarded the specific qualification.

columns.name: [Employee Qualification[GPA (Grade Point Average)]]
columns.description: The grade point average or score achieved for the specific qualification.

columns.name: [Employee Qualification[Qualification Title]]
columns.description: The name of a specific academic or professional qualification held by the employee.

columns.name: [Employee Qualification[Study End Date]]
columns.description: The date when the employee completed the specific qualification.

columns.name: [Employee Qualification[Study Start Date]]
columns.description: The date when the employee began studying for the specific qualification.

columns.name: [Entitlement Leaves[Annual Leave Entitlement]]
columns.description: The total number of annual leave days (vacation) the employee is entitled to per year.

columns.name: [Entitlement Leaves[Approved Annual Leave]]
columns.description: The number of annual leave days currently approved for the employee.

columns.name: [Entitlement Leaves[Approved Non-Mandatory Leave]]
columns.description: The number of days of discretionary or non-statutory leave that have been approved and taken.

columns.name: [Entitlement Leaves[Approved Wellbeing Leave]]
columns.description: The number of days of wellbeing/mental health leave that have been approved and taken.

columns.name: [Entitlement Leaves[Non-Mandatory Leave Entitlement]]
columns.description: The total number of non-mandatory leave days allocated to the employee per year.

columns.name: [Entitlement Leaves[Wellbeing Leave Entitlement]]
columns.description: The total number of wellbeing leave days allocated to the employee per year.
